strategy.hook: Open on a direct, personal promise in under 3 seconds so the viewer (Mum) knows it is about her.
strategy.pacing: One idea per line, 2-5 s each; each gift gets a single vivid image and one compliment.
strategy.retention: Pattern interrupt at ~60% ('But the real gift isn't any of these') re-opens the curiosity loop before the emotional payoff.
strategy.loop: The last line rhymes with the first visual (title card) so a replay feels seamless.

lines.text: Mum, I made you something no shop could ever sell.
First, roses. Every single one is a love note.
A Birkin, darling. Because you are the most iconic woman I know.
And your signature scent. Soft, unforgettable. Just like you.
But the real gift isn't any of these.
It's saying what I never say enough. You gave me strength, kindness, and a love that never ends.
Being your daughter is my greatest privilege.
Happy Mother's Day, Mum. Forever your little girl.
